I don't give many five stars, and nothing is the best or worst ever (except some reviews I've seen).  What can you say?  This is a stainless steel milk frothing pitcher that does its job for a very good price.  I don't know what else you would do to this pitcher to make it better.

I use this frothing pitcher daily! It was smaller than I imagined it would be, but turns out it's the perfect size. Good quality, no complaints.

Mine had some rough and sharp unfinished areas around the top edge so that is why only 3 stars. A minute of sanding with some 600 grit wet/dry paper removed those. I can still feel and see one bad area but it is no longer sharp and not at the spout. Otherwise the pitcher is just the right size. I already had 6 other frothing pitchers but needed a 12oz and this is just the right height and volume. Unlike my other's, there is no stamped marking on the bottom at all - usually I see the grade and type of metal and the country of origin (typically  "18/8 stainless steel made in china") but mine has nothing there. Regardless, it is fairly heavy gauge ss with 2 solid spot welds at each end of the handle attaching it to the pitcher, and it feels good in the hand. The spout is decent shape for pouring latte art, so overall a good value for the money.
